items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the base change compatibility of flat pullback with proper pushforward at the lemma labelled lemma-flat-pullback-proper-pushforward (label line 1498), whose own proof immediately follows the statement. The proof first records that the base changed morphism stays proper and that the projection stays flat of the same relative dimension, then reduces a general cycle to the class of a single integral closed subspace and rewrites that class as the class of the structure sheaf of the subspace. Through the compatibility of pullback and pushforward with cycle classes of coherent sheaves the cycle identity becomes an isomorphism of two coherent modules, which is supplied by flat base change in cohomology for the proper morphism. The counted statement records neither the reduction to a closed subspace nor the cohomological input.
